Which cylinder has twice the volume of the cylinder shown at right?

[Figure 1](attached-image-1)
Which pattern of identical squares could not be folded along the lines shown to form a cube?

Northside’s Drum and Bugle Corps raised money for a trip. The drummers and bugle players kept separate sales records. In each pair on the graph, the open bar represents drums and the shaded bar represents bugles. According to the double bar graph of monthly sales below, in what month did one group’s sales exceed the other’s by the greatest percent?

[Figure 1](attached-image-11)

Eight \(1 \times 1\) square tiles are arranged as shown so their outside edges form a polygon with a perimeter of \(14\) units. Two additional tiles of the same size are added to the figure so that at least one side of each added tile is shared with a side of one of the squares in the original figure. Which of the following could be the perimeter of the new figure?

[Figure 1](attached-image-12)

Four circles of radius \(3\) are arranged as shown. Their centers are the vertices of a square. The area of the shaded region is closest to

[Figure 1](attached-image-13)

In \(\triangle ABC,\) \(\angle A=55^\circ,\) \(\angle C=75^\circ,\) \(D\) is on side \(\overline{AB}\) and \(E\) is on side \(\overline{BC}.\) If \(DB=BE,\) then \(\angle BED=\)

[Figure 1](attached-image-14)

The convex pentagon \(ABCDE\) has \(\angle A=\angle B=120^\circ,\) \(EA=AB=BC=2\) and \(CD=DE=4.\) What is the area of \(ABCDE?\)

[Figure 1](attached-image-15)

Amy painted a dart board over a square clock face using the “hour positions” as boundaries. [See figure.] If \(t\) is the area of one of the eight triangular regions such as that between \(12\) o’clock and \(1\) o’clock, and \(q\) is the area of one of the four corner quadrilaterals such as that between \(1\) o’clock and \(2\) o’clock, then \(\frac qt=\)
